skills.name: Markdown to CSV
skills.description: Convert markdown tables to csv, with captions as metadata
skills.usage_notes: This should pull in a markdown file path and will read through the file looking for tables to convert to separate csv files with the caption as the meta data.
skills.output_format: JSON with keys: status, input_received, id_list

input_data.description: Path to csv file or markdown file.

skills.name: Plot Table
skills.description: Plot columns of a table artifact or an uploaded CSV as a PNG. If no columns are named, the skill asks, offering the real names.
